candidates.name: epididymo-orchitis
support_spans: Scrotal investigation revealed an enlarged testis, epididymis, and infected appendages.
Doppler ultrasonography: Revealed an enlarged left testis with heterogeneous echo pattern, enhanced vascularity, and retained testicular blood flow.
Pus culture isolated P. aeruginosa, susceptible to ceftazidime and ofloxacin.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings are consistent with epididymo-orchitis, an infection of the epididymis and testis.
